header: How the figures on this page were collected
text: Nothing on this page is read from a live system. Consumption and availability come out of the metering and monitoring systems once a month and are entered here by hand when the report they belong to is published; the opinions come from one postal and online survey a year. Where a figure and the printed report disagree, the report is right.
note: Maintained by the controlling team. Corrections are made in place and listed in the changelog of the annual report rather than silently.

rows.title: Population
rows.text: Every supply contract on the books at year end.

rows.title: Sample
rows.text: For the survey figures only; a response rate of 27 %.

rows.title: Method
rows.text: Consumption from the metering system, opinions from the September survey.
